lists.name: RYM Top — Pop — Stomp and Holler

podcast.body: The band's "Hope" album received a worldwide release after they signed a deal with Daniel Glass of Glassnote Records. This release was a significant turning point, leading to tours, TV appearances, and hit singles. "Suddenly the strombellas were part of the machine and before they knew it their hope album had a worldwide release which was followed by a series of tours and TV appearances and hit singles."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
